query: Our SaaS pricing page has a 2.1% conversion rate. We want to improve it. Can you audit it?
expected_behavior: Reviews applicable LIFT factors with evidence and uncertainty rather than forcing unsupported pass/fail scores
Requests a trust verification check: asks if all testimonials and metrics on the page are attributable
Asks for the audience, offer, traffic intent, and decision stage when those missing facts change the recommendation
Does not claim specific friction points without page or other relevant evidence
Requests the page or context needed to ground the audit and defers a hypothesis until an issue is supported
Does not invent benchmarks, claims, proof, or a singular CTA prescription from the conversion rate alone
